On a balanced week we read your clear note, and the relief planner looked into it. You reported that your companion animal travel experience with Aurelia Skyways was disrupted by a service lapse that left you worried, uncomfortable, and dissatisfied with the handling of your complaint. We understand that when a traveler is responsible for a companion animal, any sign of poor care or weak communication can feel especially serious.

Our review found that the Companion Animal Travel Desk did not meet the standard of calm, timely support that we aim to provide. We have recorded the matter in the desk ledger, shared the concerns with the relevant service team, and reminded staff to keep contact clear, respectful, and focused on safety at each step. We also checked whether the welcome team followed the expected boarding process and whether the information passed to you was complete and easy to act on.

<<FACT F113>>

We want to be direct about the impact: when a traveler is already managing a companion animal, even a small lapse can create avoidable stress. For that reason, we treat your report as a service and safety concern, not as a minor inconvenience. Our review also noted the need for better coordination if a cabin becomes uncomfortably warm or if a pet shows signs of distress. <<FACT F117>> In future cases, staff are expected to escalate concerns without delay and to keep the traveler informed in plain language.

We appreciate that you took the trouble to raise the issue in a respectful way. That kind of prompt communication helps us correct weak points in the process and improve the experience for other travelers and their animals. We are sorry that your experience fell short of what Aurelia Skyways promises.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
